items.t: Airbag light from spilled drinks or seat wiring contact
items.job: Repair airbag wiring and connectors, clear codes
items.note: Usually free under the recalls. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer first.

items.t: Front lower control arms rust through
items.note: Price is per side. Check your VIN for the control arm recall first. An alignment is usually needed after.

items.t: Brake light switch failure
items.note: Often free under Hyundai's brake light switch recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front airbag sensor recalls
items.job: Recalibrate or replace passenger occupant sensor
items.note: Free under the recalls. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: ABS module can short and start a fire
items.note: The recall fix is free and is often a new fuse or module. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Piston slap and cylinder wall scuffing
items.job: Replace engine with a used or remanufactured long block
items.note: Mild cold-start noise alone may not need repair. Ask a dealer about extended engine coverage for your VIN.

items.t: Transmission speed sensor faults
items.job: Replace transmission input or output speed sensor
items.note: Check the wiring per the bulletin first. If the transmission must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Key-start cars easy to steal
items.note: The anti-theft software update is free at Hyundai dealers. Price is for fixing an ignition damaged in a theft attempt.

items.t: Connecting rod bearing failure
items.note: Covered by Hyundai's extended engine warranty if the knock-sensor update was done. Check your VIN with a dealer.

items.t: Misfire with check engine light
items.job: Replace ignition coil and spark plugs
items.note: Ask the shop to check the bulletin first. If the cause is inside the engine, expect much more.

items.t: Dual-clutch shudder at low speed
items.note: A software update sometimes fixes it. Ask the dealer about the dual-clutch bulletins and any extended clutch coverage.

items.t: Oil burning from faulty piston rings
items.note: Check your VIN for the piston ring recall. Covered engines are inspected and replaced free.

items.t: CVT (IVT) check engine light
items.note: Usually done free under Hyundai's powertrain warranty for original owners.

items.t: Seat belt pretensioner can burst in a crash
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: CVT oil pressure sensor fault
items.note: Often covered by Hyundai's powertrain warranty for original owners. Ask the dealer about the bulletin first.

items.t: Fuel tank can crack and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel tank and vapor system parts
items.note: Free under recall 00V-095. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wipers can stop working (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 97V-026. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Automatic transmission slips from leaking solenoid seals (recall)
items.job: Replace transmission pressure control solenoid seals
items.note: Free under recall 99V-178. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Engine stalls at low speed from airflow sensor wiring (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 00V-259. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel tank valve may not close (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 04V-178. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Hose clamp can puncture the fuel tank (recall)
items.job: Reposition vapor hose clamp and inspect fuel tank
items.note: Free under recall 04V-208. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger airbag sensor can mistake a child seat for an adult (recall)
items.job: Recalibrate or replace passenger seat sensor system
items.note: Free under recall 05V-395. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering rack inner joints can crack (do-not-drive recall)
items.note: Free under recall 05V-187. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front seat back recliner weld may be weak (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 21V-302. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera image may not appear (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 24V-879. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering wheel emblem can fly off when the airbag fires (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 22V-632. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Idle stop oil pump controller can overheat (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 23V-526. Check the VIN first.

items.t: EGR valve short can cut engine power (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 24V-308. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wheel lug nuts or front strut fasteners may be loose (recalls)
items.job: Inspect and torque wheel nuts and strut fasteners
items.note: Free under recall 26V-693. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Side impact sensors may be assembled wrong (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace side impact sensors
items.note: Free under recall 26V-254. Check the VIN first.
